name: Air-Fryer Falafel
ingredients: ¾ cup (150 g) dried chickpeas, soaked overnight and drained (not canned)
½ small onion and 2 garlic cloves
½ cup each parsley and coriander
1 tsp each cumin and coriander powder
Dip: ½ cup plain low-fat yogurt, lemon, garlic, mint
steps: Pulse the soaked chickpeas, onion, garlic, herbs and spices to a coarse mix. Stir in the chickpea flour and baking powder; chill for 20 minutes.
Preheat the air fryer to 190°C and brush the falafel lightly with oil.
Cook for 15–18 minutes, turning halfway, until golden and crisp.
Mix the dip and serve alongside.
note: Use soaked, uncooked chickpeas, not canned, for the right texture.
